title: bb
brief: An agentic IDE that "builds itself" — it can control, customize, and automate itself, pitched as the groundwork for your own software factory. Desktop app, web app, CLI, and HTTP API are all first-class surfaces; work runs in threads you can follow live, steer at any point, or hand off to another agent. In active development; core architecture is stable, workflows and surfaces still evolving.
details: bb is an agentic IDE that bills itself as building itself — every surface (desktop app, web app, CLI, HTTP API) is a first-class way to drive it, and it can control, customize, and automate its own development. Work happens in live threads you can follow, steer mid-flight, or hand off to another agent, using whichever provider CLI you already have authenticated. Available as a macOS desktop app or via npx bb-app@latest, with nightly builds for early adopters. MIT-licensed and in active development.
